Misc

HOWTO describe colors

"#[red][green][blue]"

e.g. "#000000" would be black, "#FFFFFF" is white.

Predefined color strings:

black,
white,
red,
lightred,
darkred,
green,
lightgreen,
darkgray,
blue,
lightblue,
darkblue,
magenta,
lightmagenta,
darkmagenta,
yellow,
lightyellow,
darkyellow,
orange,
lightorange,
darkorange,
gold,
gray5, gray10, gray20, gray30, gray40,
gray50, gray60, gray70, gray80, gray90


Graphic file formats

Format Colors Notes
Windows or OS/2 Bitmap (.bmp) 4, 8, 24 or 32 bit  
JPEG (.jpg) RGB or Grayscale  
Portable Network Graphics (.png) all color formats, transparency  
Photoshop (.psd) RGB mode
8 bits/channel		 Layers will be ignored! The image can have 3 (RGB) or 4 (RGBA) channels.
